scientific_integrity: Analytic all-dimensional proof, corroborated by finite independent graph-cut and convex-hull checks; no claim of formal proof assistance or independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Canonical unweighted Euclidean graphical zonotopes of connected simple unicyclic graphs; theorem determines only the first two distinct surface-area values for n>=5 and separately n=4. Does not cover multicyclic, weighted, or affine images. Historical priority is provisional. No independent mathematical audit.
title: Sharp first and second Euclidean surface-area levels of unicyclic graphical zonotopes
